status: draft for the owner's edit (slice (f) lane, 2026-09-06)
character_sheet: The second island anchor, a variant of the first with its own texture. Three small cubes tumble slowly around a point in the sky while the entity itself does not move (its movement speed is 0): it is the anchor of a floating sand island the code builds around it and drifts a block at a time. The tumble is decorative; the island is terrain.
size_notes: 0.5 x 0.5 block hitbox; the visible cubes are much larger than the hitbox.

groups.name: shape1
groups.plain: cube 1 tumbles on all three axes at three slightly different rates (0.05, 0.051, 0.052 rad/tick), so it never repeats exactly
groups.math: Shape1.xRot = cos(t*0.05)*pi; Shape1.yRot = cos(t*0.051)*pi; Shape1.zRot = cos(t*0.052)*pi   (t = ageInTicks * WINGSPEED, WINGSPEED = 1.0)

groups.name: shape2
groups.plain: cube 2 tumbles on all three axes at three slightly different rates (0.053, 0.054, 0.055 rad/tick), so it never repeats exactly
groups.math: Shape2.xRot = cos(t*0.053)*pi; Shape2.yRot = cos(t*0.054)*pi; Shape2.zRot = cos(t*0.055)*pi   (t = ageInTicks * WINGSPEED, WINGSPEED = 1.0)

groups.name: shape3
groups.plain: cube 3 tumbles on all three axes at three slightly different rates (0.056, 0.057, 0.058 rad/tick), so it never repeats exactly
groups.math: Shape3.xRot = cos(t*0.056)*pi; Shape3.yRot = cos(t*0.057)*pi; Shape3.zRot = cos(t*0.058)*pi   (t = ageInTicks * WINGSPEED, WINGSPEED = 1.0)

behaviour: Each of the three cubes spins on all three axes at rates near 0.05 rad/tick (a turn every 108-126 ticks), with the rates offset by 0.001 so the three never line up.
No walk, no head, no state: the entity has no AI goals; its work is block placement in tick().
formulas: `ModelIslandToo.setupAnim` (ModelIslandToo.java:32-42) is the Island's nine cosines with the Island's wingspeed 1.0 — the age in ticks times 0.05 .. 0.058 radians per tick (cube 1's X, Y, Z; cube 2's; cube 3's), times pi, every angle swinging between +180 and -180 degrees with its own period (125.7 down to 108.3 ticks) — the original drew the same `ModelIsland` (orig ModelIsland.java:41-53, `render`) through RenderIslandToo. The GeckoLib hook `IslandTooGeoReplacement` calls `IslandGeoReplacement.poseIslandRig` (IslandTooGeoReplacement.java:26-28).
